proposals.label: Also drop the three most damaging storms
proposals.rationale: A handful of very costly storms can pull a fit with damage terms; trimming high-leverage points is a standard robustness check.
proposals.spec: Drop the two deadliest storms, then the three highest ndam15 rows.
proposals.source: Simonsohn, Simmons and Nelson (2020), Nature Human Behaviour 4

proposals.label: Only storms before 1979
proposals.rationale: Before 1979 every storm had a female name, so it isolates one regime.
proposals.spec: Drop the two deadliest storms, keep years < 1979.
